question: What was the yearly trend in import volume (kg) of the top 3 mineral fuel products (HS4) that showed the largest changes in import value between 2021 and 2022 in Luxembourg from 2018 to 2023?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND hs4 IN ('2710', '2701', '2715')
GROUP BY
  year,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: −14.7 % (2018–2023)
insight: The yearly trend in import volume of the top 3 mineral fuel products in Luxembourg decreased from 2018 to 2023.
The import volume was 2.92 billion kilograms in 2018 and fell to 2.49 billion kilograms in 2023.
The peak import volume was 3.11 billion kilograms in 2019.
Overall, imports declined by 14.7% between 2018 and 2023.
However, quantities are missing for part of the trade, so these volumes cover only rows with a known quantity.
